name: Santa Ana — 1921 W. Washington Ave.
summary: Real, publicly documented Habitat for Humanity of Orange County project: three duplexes, six for-sale homes for lower-income households. Site facts come from City of Santa Ana resolutions; every financial input is an ASSUMPTION, DERIVED, or a dated published reference. This is not Habitat's actual budget.

household.annual_income.note: Hypothetical household. $100,000 is below 80% of the published OC 4-person median ($138,600 × 0.8 = $110,880) and below HCD's published 4-person Low Income limit ($148,850). Not an HCD figure.

development.land_cost.note: Placeholder; actual acquisition cost UNKNOWN. Habitat OC is documented as the property owner.

development.gross_sqft_per_home.note: 10,882 sq ft documented total new floor area (Reso 2024-10 p.1) ÷ 6 homes. Held constant for 4/8-home what-ifs, so 8 homes models ~14,509 sq ft.

development.hard_cost_per_sqft.note: Not from the 2020 Terner paper; placeholder.

development.illustrative_site_capacity.note: 6 homes approved (Resolution 2024-10, PDF p.1). Counts above 6 are unapproved what-ifs.

development.additional_subsidy_budget.note: How much additional funding you assume could be raised. A comparison line only — never subtracted from the gap.

development.property_tax_carry.note: Placeholder: ~$15,000/yr × 2 years of holding. Not from assessor records; the parcel's actual tax status is UNKNOWN.

notes: Site facts are DOCUMENTED from City of Santa Ana Resolutions 2024-10 and 2024-11 (adopted June 10, 2024). The city grant is shown at a MODELED allocation that you set ($0 by default) — never assume the full $2.2M ceiling was disbursed. No real gap for this project is known.

state.note: Resolution applies the California Subdivision Map Act and Government Code §65915.

county.note: Santa Ana is in Orange County (general knowledge). The resolutions do not state the county; 'Orange County' appears only in the applicant's name.

project_type.note: Six for-sale units for lower-income households.

developer_type.note: “Habitat for Humanity of Orange County, is a non-profit housing developer.” Organizational clearance for the welfare exemption is UNKNOWN.

property_owner.note: Habitat OC is listed as Applicant & Property Owner. Acquisition date UNKNOWN.

recorded_affordability_agreement.note: Reso 2024-11 requires a Density Bonus Agreement with affordability covenants (no less than 45 years) to be recorded before any grant disbursement. Whether it has been recorded, and whether its terms meet RTC §214.15.1, is UNKNOWN.

first_time_low_income_homebuyers.note: Homes are for lower-income households (<80% AMI). A first-time-homebuyer restriction is not documented.

density_bonus_used.note: “Three additional units are allowed by the density bonus provisions in the California Density Bonus Law for a 100-percent affordability rate for six lower income units.”
